variants.label: main
variants.conf:
# nats-server settings for a profiled run (`bench run --profile --variants profile-variants.toml`): the pprof endpoint, and the block profile
# at rate 1 (every blocking event is recorded). Block profiling slows the broker, so a profiled run's timings are not comparable with runs
# without it; what it is for is where the waiting is. nats-server never sets the mutex profile, so only the block profile is useful.
prof_port: 6060
prof_block_rate: 1
